description:
Receive's binary literal is an object compared with Bin ==. That deletes binary_data_gvs, its collector and fz_matcher_eq_bytes. The interpreter's dispatch_const_eq and source.rs bitstring_eq/bitstring_payload (which copy into Vecs and leave padding unmasked) use Bin ==. hash_bitstring shares Bin's padding mask.

Acceptance:
- Receive on literals under and over 64 bytes works on all three paths.
- Two binaries differing only in padding bits compare and hash equal.
- grep shows 0 byte equalities outside Bin.
